full_page.content:
1933, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 94 Cont. Peace in (Holy Cross) parish -
Laurncia Vermeersch - 28 - sinus, had operation 8 yrs. ago - very little help.
M. M. fears nervous Br.
Fr. McClory S.J. Mrs. Paula Demenlenaere - 16 - nervous Brk. Mrs. Mary A. Gibbs .... & Co. Oil .... Cemetery Rosemary C. - 6 - mental weak
Mrs. Josephine Gurreau - 46 - Goiter, nerves Geo Nessen - 42 - drinking, away - home. Blank Page
Page 95 Page 96 March 8 Mrs. Rose Lical - 56 - cancer of breast Mrs. Cath. Wilson - flats to rent ... or lose. Elizabeth Huff - 70 - in Grace Hospital, cancer feared Mrs. DeWitt - nervous
Ernest Hyland - 42 - stomach cancer - (of Windsor) formerly an orangeman - 7yrs. past teaching Catechism to his children; ex- pecting operation, wife gently reminds him to prepare for what might be. He invites her to his First Communion. .. received on First Friday - was baptized last Wednesday ..... had prepared the happy surprise for his wife and mother-in-law, latter had been bed-ridden for four years. could not be moved without bones be- ing broken. When she heard of the conversion of son-in-law, she sighed aloud "now my work is finished". She also received Com- munion last Friday and died next day - (last Sat. ) Mr. Hyland's little daughter aged 8, died peacefully after fearful suffering. She assured her father that she was offering all for his conver- sion ......... Operation undertaken, had to be abandoned. Find- ing two big cancers in stomach, Dr. orders "sew him up". . . March 12 improving. .. . March 18 fever up to 106 - still conscious.
Mrs. Ada Smith - still owes small amount ($8) on furniture ... Co. wants to take it back because of small fraction - all out of work.
